sloka: राक्षसाश्च महावीर्या वानराश्च महाबलाः ।सर्व एव समाजग्मुर्महात्मानः कुतूहलात् ।। ७.९६.७ ॥
transliteration: rākṣasāśca mahāvīryā vānarāśca mahābalāḥ ।sarva eva samājagmurmahātmānaḥ kutūhalāt ।। 7.96.7 ॥

translations.english: All the great-souled demons of immense valor and monkeys of great strength assembled there out of curiosity.
